description: List the organization's whiteboards -- shared visual canvases where people sketch and arrange sticky notes together, sometimes alongside a meeting. Returns each board's id, title, status ('draft', 'active', or 'filed'), the meeting it is attached to if any, who created it, and when it last changed. Filter by status, or by meeting_id to find the board a specific meeting used. This is the index only; use read_whiteboard to see what is written on a board.

meeting_id.description: Only boards attached to this meeting

name: list_whiteboards
